actual_cases.semantics: Clear alpha unless minRGB<140 OR maxRGB-minRGB>60. Crop selected full-height columns. Target dimensions round(sourceSize*scale*4), minimum1; precompute RGB*alpha float then clip/truncate to uint8. BICUBIC separately filters RGB-premultiplied image and alpha Gray; positions round(at*4), clip to supersampled canvas. Merge alpha by maximum but ADD premultiplied RGB across segments, then divide by max(alpha,1e-6),clip. Morphological sticker/extrusion and Layer.paint/down/put follow. This is not ordinary alphaOver, Pillow RGBA resize, or existing LANCZOS.

provider_only_copy_contract.facts: copy src[x,y,w,h] reads immutable orig only if from=orig; defaultwork snapshots whole current image before crop. Destination[x,y] replaces exactRGBA; destination[x,y,w,h] tiles source crop to fill and truncates final tile. No resize/blend. mixed_zero_tracking.note: Origin rounding precedes icon rounding: dx=round(geo.ox+(pad+13+gap*4)/4). Computing round(anchorX+13/4+gap) instead gives16 for10.25 and is WRONG; correct15.

icon_only_tracking_caveat.reason: measure subtracts tracking only when total text-character n>0; text_layer unconditionally tw=sum(adv)-trk. Icons contribute no text characters. This is an actual provider discrepancy, not a new policy to silently correct.
icon_only_tracking_caveat.active_recipe_evidence: Bounded batch_b8inline ops are mixed text; no icon-only operation selected/proven. Keep only-icon nonzero tracking held/refused in next finite extension unless deliberate compatibility decision.

placement_equations: Icon advance SS=(sourceWidth+2*gap)*SS/sx, independent of text size; reserve fixed source-pixel width plus gaps.
Icon cursor=xx+gap*SS/sx; increment xx by whole icon advance; zero tracking keeps per-text-run native draw reset, positive tracking advances continuous globalcursor.
After place sets rounded geo.ox/oy: icon_left=geo.ox+cursor*sx/SS, icon_centerY=geo.oy+(base*sy-cap*sy/2)/SS.
Copy destination=(round(icon_left),round(icon_centerY-iconHeight/2)), Python ties-to-even. Copy source full RGBA unchanged, no scaling or alpha blend.
op_lines composites each text line, applies optional from_orig fill, THEN copies that line icons; next line composition sees prior icons. Do not defer all icons to end of group.

Enhance renderRuns measurement/cursor geometry and existing BitmapLayer placement facts; composeCells copies original exact RGBA immediately after each individual text line. Existing authorTexture already owns the base source decode, so same-sheet icons require no new donor loader or PNG asset.
smallest_useful_next_direction.no_new_function: Existing renderRuns reasonably owns fixed icon width/gap and placement alongside text; composeCells reasonably owns ordered replacement and containment alongside line composition. No new image composer/CLI/blend helper or donor engine required. Do not force generic crop/reconstruction modes into renderRuns.
smallest_useful_next_direction.containment: Preflight complete source rectangle and complete destination rectangle inside source image/approved cell; transparent donor pixels may change hiddenRGB, so alpha-only ink containment is insufficient. Preserve base/atlas immutability, resource bounds, duplicate identities and existing text cells. Failure must precede candidate publication. Historical final clipping/restoration is not silently accepted as strict spill success.
smallest_useful_next_direction.metric_constraints: Use original pixel dimensions for icon width/height; gap2 on both sides, not font-size scaling. Root decides finite schema and validation after source study. Onlyicon nonzero tracking discrepancy stays explicit; do not silently normalize it.
smallest_useful_next_direction.codec_handoff: Raw candidate donor bytes and final indexed source-color snap/native palette projection are distinct oracles. Existing texture/source policy performs projection; copying a donor does not authorize palette mutation or claim source index preservation for new colors.
